value.rationale: The 2026 motivating theorem guarantees universal four-body stabilization. A natural ecological design gap is whether three-body terms can suffice with the original growth/pairwise coefficients and target fixed. The sharp general answer, exceptional codimension, and a rank-one nilpotent construction supply structural guidance about interaction order rather than a numerical tuning or routine one-example corollary; the result has mathematically meaningful limitations.
